purpose: Evidence-bounded behavioral strategy contract; not a model artifact and not an order authorization.

layers.name: 目标库存 / 当前仓位状态
layers.claim: Non-idle behavior is strongly conditioned by current exposure and position state; the public record supports a stateful position-adjustment description.
layers.implementation_boundary: Use the robot's own reconciled position and history only; never use the teacher's future or post-action state during autonomous replay.

layers.name: 稀疏的开仓 / 加仓 / 减仓 / 平仓 / 反手调整
layers.claim: Most eligible clock rows are NO_TRADE; observed non-idle rows contain directional opens, adds, reductions, closes and flips.
layers.implementation_boundary: A candidate must preserve an explicit NO_TRADE path and must not turn every indicator fluctuation into an order.

layers.name: 被动挂单表达目标库存
layers.claim: Layered limit/GTC execution is a plausible implementation of the observed inventory-adjustment behavior, supported by an independent public analysis, but it is not proven to be the trader's private rule.
layers.implementation_boundary: Use venue-native price, tick, lot, fee and post-only semantics; one net target per venue instrument and at most one active bot order.

evidence.source_claim: planned inventory was associated with limit orders in the public execution record

layers.name: 必要时的主动纠偏
layers.claim: Market/IOC-style execution can be used only as a bounded urgency override when passive execution cannot safely correct the target; this is an implementation hypothesis, not an identified trigger.
layers.implementation_boundary: Require explicit urgency and risk checks, keep ReduceOnly for reductions, and fail closed when market context, account reconciliation or order state is stale.

evidence.source_claim: urgent corrections were associated with active fills

layers.name: 仓位周期与风险包络
layers.claim: The record is better described as position episodes with repeated adjustments than as isolated independent trades; holding duration and action interval are measurable, while the private risk limits are not.
layers.implementation_boundary: Use observed historical distributions only as bounded risk references; do not infer unlimited leverage or assume past exposure is a safe future limit.

layers.name: RSI / MACD / 布林带等指标
layers.claim: Indicators are valid causal model inputs when computed from already-closed bars, but correlations and bucket lifts do not establish that the original trader used these indicators or that they caused an action.
layers.implementation_boundary: Keep indicator features leakage-safe and explicitly label them as model-input evidence; missing funding, mark/index or microstructure context must remain missing.

layers.name: 下单前精确触发时机
layers.claim: The current public export does not identify the exact pre-action trigger, quote state, order-book condition, cancellation intent or private decision rule.
layers.implementation_boundary: Do not convert the conditional event benchmark into a deployable timing signal; any autonomous timing model remains research-only until independently observed pre-action context is available.

layers.name: 跨交易所统一行为层 + 原生执行层
layers.claim: The same trader identity can support a shared high-level intent vocabulary, but executable behavior remains venue-native because contract scale, funding, liquidity, symbol coverage and order semantics differ.
layers.implementation_boundary: Keep BitMEX and Hyperliquid evidence separated; share only venue-neutral intent features, then calibrate exposure and execution per venue.

prohibited_claims: The robot has exactly recovered the original trader's private strategy.
The trader definitely used RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands or any other named indicator.
Historical replay results guarantee future profitability.
BitMEX and Hyperliquid are executable-policy interchangeable.
The specification itself authorizes live or mainnet orders.

sources.name: Paul Wei Hyperliquid BTC tracker
sources.limitations: A replay of public candles, fills, orders and state snapshots; it does not by itself expose a complete pre-action quote/order-book history or private decision rule.

sources.name: TradeTrace Paul Wei trading pattern research
sources.role: independent interpretation of observable execution and inventory patterns
sources.limitations: Secondary analysis, not a private strategy disclosure or proof of causality; its conservative rules remain hypotheses.

conclusion: The strongest defensible result is a sparse, stateful inventory-adjustment approximation with venue-native execution. Action type and sizing are partly observable once an event is known, but exact autonomous timing and the trader's private trigger remain unidentifiable from the current public record.
